metadata.description: Claude Code mods powered by the Composio CLI

plugins.name: composio-daily
plugins.description: Standup pane, seen-this-before error lookup and agent-busy Slack status, through the Composio CLI

plugins.name: composio-pulse
plugins.description: Times every composio CLI call into a status-line sparkline against a latency budget, and blocks re-linking a connected toolkit

plugins.name: link-prefetch
plugins.description: Paste a Slack thread, Linear issue or GitHub PR link and Claude gets its contents as context before it answers

plugins.name: review-chaser
plugins.description: /reviews pane: open ComposioHQ PRs waiting on reviewers, with a Slack nudge per reviewer

plugins.name: review-lint
plugins.description: Hands Claude a cache-review checklist or test rules when an edit adds a cache or a brittle test assertion

plugins.name: snippet
plugins.description: /snippet drafts your daily Slack update from Linear + GitHub and posts it on one press

plugins.name: ticket-band
plugins.description: Linear ticket for the current branch above the prompt, with one-press Done once every PR merged
